referenceFidelity.findings: The San Francisco cafe reference establishes an illustrated laboratory universe. This original graphic uses a large Octocat, planets, circuit contours and a row of machines; it deliberately simplifies the dense original wall.

construction.findings: Graphic contours are closed shallow solids on a continuous framed wall; nose/eyes and smile sit above the face. Corrected centre tentacle to a curling path instead of a folded vertical stroke. Oblique view retains fitted depth and uninterrupted panel boundary.

readability.findings: Planet, Octocat and machine row remain distinct at phone framing. The larger character provides an identifiable focus even when tiny details simplify.

motion.findings: Static wall-mounted graphic panel, no rig or clips requested.

secondPass.findings: Finished GLB compared again with the six reference photographs after centre-tentacle correction on character panels. Front and close-up retain consistent face/ear landmarks; oblique has no detached graphic edges; rear is intentionally plain and closed; phone captures were reframed after viewport reduction. No additional scoped construction repair remains.

userAcceptance.note: Author review completed; user artistic acceptance is not inferred.

limitations: Original simplified graphic interpretations, not replicas of commissioned paintings.
Panel dimensions are authored; source photographs are reference-only.
